status.label: Review complete — maintainer takeover decision
status.detail: First-time contributor PR with CLA and spelling checks green, detailed author validation, and no Phase 0 process blocker. The rebased five-file review diff received a fresh Copilot review with zero comments and has zero unresolved fork threads. Runner, Settings, FancyZones module interface, FancyZones app, unit-test, and UI-test builds passed in x64 Debug; all three new AUMID regression tests passed. The full native test suite reports no failed tests but the VS 18 test host crashes during DLL unload, so that teardown issue remains an environmental validation caveat.

next_action.label: Decide whether to take over the author branch
next_action.reason: The author explicitly said they no longer have a Windows test environment and asked whether to apply an untested partial suggestion. The safe response is to ask them not to do that and let a maintainer apply the complete validated change set.

actions.label: Reply that maintainers can take over

comment.body: Thanks for the update. Please don't apply an untested partial change. The empty-path guard needs to land together with the `noexcept` correction, legacy-history migration/tombstone handling, and regression coverage; otherwise the fallback can restore a history the user removed. Since maintainers can update this branch, no action is needed from you right now—we can prepare and validate that complete patch, then ask you to confirm the intended PWA/profile behavior.

actions.note: Draft only. Never post without explicit maintainer approval.

actions.label: Re-run if upstream activity changes
actions.note: Refresh the source head and conversation, then rebase and reconverge before proposing any new upstream action.
